notes: Added Scheduled activation mode with configurable weekdays and start/end times directly in the menu bar.
Vesila now automatically evaluates your schedule when the app launches and when your Mac wakes or resumes.
Manual changes during a scheduled window now apply only to the current window, so the next scheduled window starts fresh.
Added a global Vesila activation toggle for easier control.
Improved Stay Active When Locked behavior.
Improved system state synchronization and reliability.
